## Phase log

- **Setup (2026-05-21).** Workspace scaffolding + toolchain (Quarto 1.8.27, Python 3.11 venv, KaTeX). See `phase1_setup_summary.md`, `phase2_setup_summary.md`.
- **Phase 0 — Inventory & planning (2026-05-22).** All sources read and extracted to `phase0/`. STOP gate cleared (no C6 halt). Mid-build model override: all sub-agents moved to Opus 4.7; four Sonnet-produced extract batches re-done on Opus (originals archived to `phase0/_sonnet_provisional/`, listed in `phase0/sonnet_produced_files.md`). See `phase0_summary.md`.
- **Phase 1 — Site skeleton & infrastructure (2026-05-22, complete).** Created `_quarto.yml` (website, full sidebar nav, KaTeX), `theme/custom.scss` (color system + callouts + two-mode math visibility), `theme/toggle.js` (+ `toggle-after-body.html` include), `index.qmd` (landing dashboard + preface + math-mode demo), and appendix pages (`notation_table`, `math_appendix` scaffold, `sources`, this log). 31 page stubs generated for the full nav. **Skeleton render (1.6) verified:** all 36 pages build; sidebar shows every section; theme/family-colors compile into `site_libs`; KaTeX renders; math-toggle script + `gra4160.mathMode` present on every page; largest page 63 KB (C4 ✓); zero remote `http(s)` script/link srcs (offline ✓).

  **Two infrastructure decisions (deviations from the literal spec, intent preserved):**
  1. **`embed-resources: true` turned OFF (deviates from C10).** It is incompatible with a cross-linked multi-page website: Quarto tries to inline every linked sibling page, producing a page-on-page cascade (notation_table hit **36 MB**, far over the C4 8 MB ceiling, with "Could not fetch resource" warnings). Offline use is instead achieved via Quarto's standard local `site_libs/` bundling. Net effect: same offline guarantee, pages ~50–60 KB instead of 12–36 MB.
  2. **KaTeX vendored locally (`assets/katex/`).** Quarto's `html-math-method: katex` defaults to the jsdelivr **CDN** (violates C8/6.5 offline). Fetched KaTeX 0.16.11 via npm at build time, copied the dist (js/css + 60 font files) into `assets/katex/`, and set `html-math-method: {method: katex, url: "assets/katex/"}` + `resources: assets/katex/**`. Quarto depth-adjusts the URL per page (`../assets/katex/...` in subdirs), so math is fully offline at every depth. (Runtime is offline; only the one-time build-time npm fetch used the network.)

## Deviations from spec (documented, offline/quality intent preserved)
- **`embed-resources` OFF** → offline via local `site_libs/` (C10 mechanism changed, offline intent met — `embed-resources` is incompatible with a cross-linked website; see Phase 1).
- **KaTeX vendored** to `assets/katex/` (Quarto's default is a CDN; vendoring satisfies C8 offline at every page depth).
- **Observable Plot used throughout** (not Plotly) — smaller bundle, R6/C4-aligned; so 6.4's "every Plotly graph-div" check is N/A by design (no Plotly used).
- **Sidebar nav not family-colored per item** — the family signal is carried instead by each page's header color + `fam-badge` opener + primary viz color (per-item Quarto sidebar coloring would need fragile sidebar CSS).
- **`methods/nn_pytorch.qmd` §4** Iris numbers remain qualitative + `[VERIFY]` — PyTorch deliberately not installed in `.venv` (~2 GB; Tier-2 page); the marker is intentional (user decision). No fabrication.

- Math-appendix sections all filled (Phase 3.A); RF links `#sec-biasvar` (the relevant shared foundation — no tree-specific anchor required).
